name: search_clinical_trials
description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials related to a specific medical condition. Returns trial IDs, titles, and recruitment status. Use this tool when you need information about ongoing or completed clinical trials for a particular condition. Do NOT use this tool for non-clinical trial data or for searching other databases; use 'search_pubmed' for literature searches instead.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: The medical condition to search for in clinical trials, represented as a free-text string. Should be specific enough to yield relevant results (e.g. 'diabetes', 'breast cancer').

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of trials to return, must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter results by recruitment status. Must be one of: 'Recruiting', 'Not yet recruiting', 'Completed', 'Terminated', 'Suspended', 'Withdrawn'. If omitted, all statuses are included.

trials.description: List of clinical trials matching the search criteria. Each item includes: trial_id (string), title (string), recruitment_status (string).

total_count.description: Total number of trials found matching the criteria, which may exceed max_results.

return_schema.description: Object containing 'trials' (list of trial metadata) and 'total_count' (total matches before truncation).
